speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Pancreatic Cancer. The patient is a 55-year-old male with significant risk factors including smoking, chronic alcohol use, and a history of steroid use, presenting with progressive right arm weakness, sensory loss, unexplained weight loss of 17 pounds, and diabetes. These symptoms are highly suggestive of a pancreatic mass causing painless jaundice or direct compression of the brachial plexus (Pancoast tumor) or metastatic disease.
